metadata.description: Put websites online at simple-host.app from your AI app or coding agent: every site at its own address, saved data with rules for who reads and writes, visitor sign-in, a passcode or named viewers, visit numbers, a short name or your own domain, and teams.

plugins.name: simple-host
plugins.description: Describe a website and it goes online at its own address. Claude builds the site and publishes it to simple-host.app through the Simple Host connector: pages, saved data (tables, values and files) with visitor sign-in for bookings, forms and sign-ups, who may open the site (everyone, a passcode, named people), visit numbers, a short name or your own domain, and teams.
